o: how much damage a leaked credential can do
one small key per job that can do only that job
why: Limits what a leak can do.

q: Prompt injection can leak secrets because …
o: an AI agent may follow instructions hidden in content it reads
why: So don't hand agents broad keys.

q: A personal SSH key that deploys can also usually push code and log in elsewhere.
why: Fact: that's why a deploy-only key is safer.
